Proud of 74 years of establishment and development

In 1951, in the rustic tea land, the brand was born with a passion to create rich cups of tea. Since then, Ngo Gia has become one of the favorite tea brands thanks to stable quality, dedicated service and constant innovation to keep up with the trends of Vietnamese youth.
Safe, hygienic and delicious. The use of safe, natural and hygienic ingredients is the top priority of Ngo Gia Black Tea.
Ngo Gia Black Tea wishes to satisfy customers best with professional and friendly service attitude.
Based on two core foundations: Quality and Service, Ngo Gia Black Tea always strives to build a reliable brand.
Ngo Gia Black Tea is committed to bringing sophisticated, healthy and safe drinks for health. Each cup of tea is the enthusiasm of the craftsman, sending Vietnamese pride.
Becoming a pioneering brand in the field of high-quality drinks in Vietnam, trusted and loved by consumers. Ngo Gia aims for sustainable development.

Ngo Gia Black Tea always listens, understands and constantly improves to bring the best tea experience to you. Each cup of tea is brewed not only with sophisticated flavors, but also with appreciation and dedication to each guest.
